knownBaselineLimitation: The original starter retains regex.test(batch) coercion without a string type check. This archive preserves original statements; an explicit valid new batch must be set and verified before use. It does not claim that inherited early guard was repaired.
samplingLimits: Sampled peaks are lower bounds; short spikes/processes and activity before first observation can be missed.
RSS can double-count shared pages; PSS is separate, and reads are sequential, not atomic.
VmHWM is per-process lifetime high-water and is not summed; external browser/services are not attributed.
Visible meminfo is shared-environment reference, not Jb usage.
Exact root argv is checked but not saved; generated metrics are excluded.
excludedCategories: PREPARED, BASELINE, SELFTEST, review notes and full directory inventories
real run data, metrics/process samples and original results
actual SQL/control/DB/public JSON and raw evidence
credentials, environment, dependencies and runtime identity artifacts
recoveryLimits: Original Novartis heap512 host, producer, configuration and session bindings are separate prerequisites.
The sampler is archived under memory-observation but the source and tests expect its historical fixed absolute path and SHA. Restore reviewed placement or perform separately reviewed adaptation.
The prelaunch test also needs its excluded BASELINE.json and referenced original files; it is not independently reproducible from this safe package alone.
Original source, command, heap512, quality/freshness gates, dependencies and runtime identity are unchanged.
The wrapper returns the target exit even under shell errexit and observer failure, per reported synthetic tests; this is not a real Novartis memory result.
No active workflow, CI, merge, deployment or default-branch update.
